## 更新 · What's new

- Mac：「保持唤醒」在重启和重装后记住之前的开关状态，应用退出时仍正常释放电源断言。
  Mac: Keep Awake now remembers its on/off state across restarts and reinstalls while releasing its power assertion on quit.
- Mac：截图预览改用 `IOSurface` 并将 Common Relay 升级到 `v0.1.6`（`NWConnection`），消除缓存/WebSocket 泄漏并优化断线重连探测。
  Mac: screenshot previews now use `IOSurface` and Common Relay upgrades to `v0.1.6` (`NWConnection`), eliminating buffer/WebSocket leaks and stabilizing reconnect probes.
- Mac：菜单栏图标记住位置且首次启动默认靠右；无分类打开设置时自动回到顶部。
  Mac: the menu-bar icon remembers its position and defaults near the right edge on first launch; opening Settings without a category scrolls to the top.
